paragraphs.text:
You catch up with Norman and Sylvia and cut into the woods. 
Finally, the three of you pause for breath. Norman stares at 
you as he leans against a tree. “What were those things, Professor? 
What happened to Bernard? And Charlie?”

To circle back and try to find out what happened to your missing 
comrades, go to 152. To put as much distance between you and the 
creatures as possible, go to 147.
